description_en: Queries the passwords for the accounts within a cloud computer image. For example, when the Chrome browser on the cloud computer queries the cached password, it requires the end user to enter the password for identity verification
description_zh: 查询云电脑镜像内账号的密码。例如，在云电脑上的Chrome浏览器查询缓存的密码时，会要求终端用户输入该密码进行验证
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-users-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gq8u6whi9f6k80000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUsersPassword
